item.text: [{"task_id":"84db8fc4~v","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    exterior = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    interior = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    low = int(round(params['bounds'][0]))","    unit = int(round(params['bounds'][1]))","    directions = [(int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))) for pair in params['directions']]","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    seen = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)","    pending = []","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            if grid[r, c] == background:","                out[r, c] = interior","                if r == low or c == low or r == h - unit or c == w - unit:","                    seen[r, c] = True","                    pending.append((r, c))","    while pending:","        r, c = pending.pop()","        out[r, c] = exterior","        for dr, dc in directions:","            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","            if low <= nr < h and low <= nc < w:","                if not seen[nr, nc] and grid[nr, nc] == background:","                    seen[nr, nc] = True","                    pending.append((nr, nc))","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"bounds":[2],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[0,1,4],"bounds":[0,1],"directions":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Replace zero regions connected to the grid boundary through orthogonal zero neighbors with 1; replace enclosed zero regions with 4.
